name: zeffect_anim_load_activation_records
description: zEffect_Anim::LoadActivationRecords restores Activation#### section payloads, clears first-section queued state, queues node-token -1 records, and restores tracked Object3D node state.
binary_ninja_evidence: 0x4606d0 compares the section token with Activation0000, resets each queued activation record, clears the activation-record table, and clears bit 0x4000 on entries 1..count-1 and their runtime siblings.

For the current payload it resolves base.animName, optionally dispatches NodeActionCallback/ProcessActivationRecord when nodeToken is nonnegative, sets entry flag 0x4000, handles saved activation states 1/2/3/4/6, queues the base record when nodeToken is -1, and restores tracked Object3D active/transform/DI state.
known_limits: Binary Ninja reports expected LLIL flag-generation warnings for the inline strcmp sbb sequence at 0x46070f; assembly control flow was used as primary evidence.
code/function tier S byte verification remains deferred to a coherent zEffect animation save/load source-cluster pass.
